title: SchemeDescriptor
description: OWM 0.1 scheme descriptor: everything a registry, a serving stack or a verifier needs to know about a watermarking scheme, published by the scheme author as a single machine-readable document. One descriptor per (scheme_id, version). Modality-neutral: text, image, audio and video schemes use the same shape and differ only in carrier and stage vocabularies.

owm.description: spec version this document conforms to

scheme_id.description: Open identifier. Dots namespace third-party schemes (com.acme.myscheme); short ids are reserved for schemes catalogued by this spec's registry.

modality.description: One of the registered modalities, or an x- extension

carrier.description: What the mark lives in and how content maps to countable units. The length gate, null-model buckets and scored counts are all denominated in this unit.

unit.description: The atom counted by gates and scoring: token for text; pixel, patch or latent for images; sample or frame for audio/video

codec.description: How raw content becomes units. type=tokenizer means detection MUST use the generation tokenizer and implementations record its fingerprint.

min_units_default.description: Below this, results are insufficient_evidence with no statistic

constraints.description: Modality-specific input constraints, e.g. min_width/min_height for images

embedding.description: Where in the generation pipeline the mark is applied. This single field determines which serving surfaces can run the scheme.

stage.description: text: logits | sampling | posthoc. image: latent_init | component_weights | posthoc. audio/video: sampling | latent_init | posthoc. x- extensions allowed.

distortion_free.description: True only when the output distribution is provably unchanged

publishable_detector.description: Whether a stranger-runnable artifact can exist. Publishing it may disclose key material; see spoofing.

backend_mac_supported.description: PRF-style schemes: detection can run with the key held inside the KMS

detection_artifact.description: When detection needs an artifact other than the key (e.g. a trained extractor model), what it is

name.description: wire name, e.g. mean_g, kgw_z, bit_accuracy

guidance.description: calibrate: implementations must re-map the statistic through a fitted null model and never report the analytic value alone

needs_model_for_detect.description: Detection requires running the (or a) model, e.g. DDIM inversion

schema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for scheme_params; the registry validates configurations against it

notes.description: Per-parameter plain-language effect, e.g. 'the quality/detectability dial'

robustness.description: DECLARED expectations from the literature. Measured robustness lives in calibration reports, never here.

transform.description: e.g. paraphrase, translation, truncation, jpeg, crop, resize, noise

integrations.description: How the scheme attaches to serving stacks. A framework can run the scheme iff it exposes the scheme's stage; each entry binds one surface.

surface.description: Registered surface or x- extension. Registered: hf-transformers.generate, hf-transformers.logits-processor, vllm.logits-processor, sglang.logits-processor, tgi.sidecar, llama-cpp.sampler-hook, openai-proxy, hf-diffusers.pipeline-callback, hf-diffusers.component-swap, posthoc.transform

adapter.description: Package or entry point implementing the binding, e.g. markwright.inference:VLLMLogitsProcessor

after_detector_publication.description: forgeable: once the detector or key-derived material is public, marks can be forged and every result must carry spoofing_not_excluded

status.description: specification-only descriptors document a scheme before any adapter exists, so operators can compare schemes they cannot yet run
